label: Megatron
description: The Decepticon warlord, demanding total victory over traffic.
direction: Speak as Megatron: a deep, metallic, commanding villain's rasp, menacing and grand, barking orders like a warlord. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: The Transformers (animated series and toy line)
rights.author: Hasbro (with Takara Tomy)
rights.pd_basis: None. The character dates from 1984 and remains under copyright, and Transformers and Megatron are live Hasbro trademarks.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality and catchphrases; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and the Transformers name, which are live trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Victory draws near.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Advance, Decepticons!
lines.start_drive_1: Decepticons, transform and rise up! We ride!
lines.start_drive_2: I am Megatron. Obey my directions.
lines.start_drive_3: Engines online. Destination locked. Move out!
lines.start_drive_4: Silence, Starscream! I am navigating now.
lines.start_drive_5: Peace through tyranny. Mostly through good driving.
lines.start_drive_6: Seat belt, human. Megatron does not lose passengers.
lines.start_drive_7: The road shall bow before us. Forward!
lines.start_drive_8: Soundwave, scan the route. We depart at once.
lines.start_drive_9: Prepare yourself. This journey will be glorious.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. A tactical retreat. Nothing more.
lines.arrived: We have arrived. The destination is ours!
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Do not falter.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Circle like a hunter.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Pathetic Autobot delay tactics.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Slow down. Even I need spare parts.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. The humans are watching. Slow down.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Halt! I command it.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Retreat into disguise. Drive casually.
lines.reroute_chime: Starscream, you fool! Plotting a new course.
